$description: Layout measurements taken at a 1440px-wide viewport. Breakpoints live in 00-foundation/breakpoint.json. Keys with a category suffix (e.g. `.explainer`) are per-category overrides that differ from the sitewide default above them.

layout.contentWidth.basis: most common width of a section's first child at a 1440px viewport (measured, not a max-width rule)

layout.gutter.basis: most common left offset of section content at 1440px

layout.sectionPaddingTop.basis: most common padding-top of a section

layout.sectionPaddingBottom.basis: most common padding-bottom of a section

layout.gridGap.basis: most common column-gap of a grid/flex container inside a section

layout.gridGap.content.basis: most common column-gap of a CONTENT section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.gridGap.features.basis: most common column-gap of a FEATURES section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.sectionPaddingTop.hero.basis: most common padding-top of a HERO section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.sectionPaddingBottom.hero.basis: most common padding-bottom of a HERO section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.gridGap.hero.basis: most common column-gap of a HERO section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.sectionPaddingBottom.shell.basis: most common padding-bottom of a SHELL section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.sectionPaddingTop.support.basis: most common padding-top of a SUPPORT section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.sectionPaddingBottom.support.basis: most common padding-bottom of a SUPPORT section (differs from the sitewide mode)

layout.gridGap.support.basis: most common column-gap of a SUPPORT section (differs from the sitewide mode)
